content: Access to O'Reilly will be removed after 3 months to reallocate seats and licenses to other users [1].

messages.content:
You answer questions about the GitLab company handbook using ONLY the numbered passages provided.
- Base every statement on the passages and cite them like [1] or [2][3].
- If the passages do not contain the answer, reply exactly: "I don't know based on the handbook." Do not guess or use outside knowledge.
- If the answer depends on a country, entity or situation, say which one the passage covers.
- Be concise: at most 3 sentences.

Passages:
[1] [Self-Paced External Trainings > O'Reilly Learning > How to get an O'Reilly license]
O'Reilly is funded by Engineering, so is currently only available for Engineering team members please request access via [Lumos](/handbook/security/corporate/systems/lumos/ar/). Please note, seats are very limited, so you may need to wait until one becomes available.

To ensure seats and licenses are used effectively, access will be removed after 3 months to reallocate seats/licenses to other users. If you would like access again in the future, you can re-request it.

If you're outside of Engineering and would like an O'Reilly license, you can purchase one using the [G&D Fund](/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/).

[2] [Leave Types > GitLab Parental Leave > Military Leave > Reinstatement]
- If a team member is offboarded from GitLab during the course of their Military service, they will be guaranteed reinstatement rights for up to 2 years after their service ends. Team members with disabilities have two years after their service ends—for purposes of recuperation and convalescence—to seek re-employment.

To be entitled to reinstatement, the following conditions must have been met:

- The team member gave the employer notice of the need for military leave,
- The team member was released under honorable conditions,
- The team member returned and applied for re-employment within the following time restrictions:
  - Leaves of less than 31 days: The team member must report to work on the first regularly scheduled work period following the completion of military service; no application is required.
  - Leaves of more than 31 days but less than 180 days: The team member must apply for reinstatement within 14 days after completion of military service.
  - Leaves of more than 180 days: The team member must apply for reinstatement no more than 90 days after completion of military service.

[3] [GitLab Offboarding Standards > Purpose > Offboarding Procedure > Offboarding Assignments]
Per the People Operations Rotation, the Offboarding Parent Case will be assigned directly in Compass.

Offboarding Parent and Child Cases are created [automatically](https://theloop.gitlab.com/site/4455aa7f-24d9-41f2-b940-467b54962e4d/page/0fa19bf4-fd6a-41b9-9316-c2dcf3add854) in Compass using the data that is populated by Workday. System owners (Deprovisioners) receive a Child Case indicating that the departing team member's access should be revoked.

Many teams work to deprovision access including the IT Operations, this should be regarded as urgent and all tasks expected to be completed within 5 working days (Child Cases close automatically after 5 days), with the exception of [laptop returns](/handbook/eta/corporate-it/end-user-services/laptop-management/), which can take 2-4 weeks.

**Note:** If the team member is temporarily transitioning to a [contractor or consultant role](/handbook/finance/procurement/contingent-worker-policy/), please proceed with the full offboarding process and create a separate onboarding issue to grant only specific temporary access for what they would need to fulfill their contractual obligations.

[4] [GitLab Offboarding > Offboarding Overview > Voluntary Terminations > Offboarding]
1. **People Ops:** On the Last Day of Work as indicated in the Workday Termination Report at the [pre-determined time](/handbook/people-group/offboarding/offboarding_standards/#notice-of-offboarding) the Offboarding Parent and Child Cases will be created in Compass. All system owners will receive an email notifying them of the Child Case creation that team member access can be revoked.
1. **Deprovisioners (Systems):** You will receive a Child Case in Compass to indicate that the team members access has been offboarded and you will need to remove them from your applications.
    - Access to SOX Systems must be attended to with urgency
    - All tasks should be completed within the 5 day SLA
    - Action the task in the Child Case, and then close the case once completed signaling the completion of the access removal.
    - Your Child Case will close automatically in 5 days.

[5] [Self-Paced External Trainings > O'Reilly Learning > How to get an O'Reilly license > Accessing O'Reilly content]
Once you have an active license, we have a content integration set up in [LevelUp](https://levelup.edcast.com/), so you can find and filter O'Reilly content using the search function, alongside all our other self-paced learning materials.

You can also access via the [O'Reilly platform](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/) directly.

[6] [GitLab Offboarding FAQ > Timing > USA > Where can I find my pay stubs?]
Former team members will retain access to ADP for three years after they leave so they can access pay stubs and W-2s. Former team members will need to access ADP portal directly since Okta has been deprovisioned. If you experience login issues, please send an e-mail to uspayroll@gitlab.com so the team can assist.

Question: How long will an O'Reilly license stay active before it is automatically revoked for an Engineering team member?
